summary: Expanded source review covers 69 creative fields with 554 planned repository queries and 18 model tasks, including a new neural video-reshooting field and deeper targeted pagination. This edition completes 19 earlier screened entries and provides 37 detailed guides plus seven additional screened leads: 25 net new library tools. The first weekly curation batch has fresh six-criterion assessments for 55 previously published tools, alongside fresh guide assessments for 19 earlier screened tools. Most of the starting library remains due; the searchable library shows the current remaining count. Decart-XR changes to Experimental on current prototype evidence; five evidence gaps close without popularity-based promotions. New entries receive dated assessments too. Weekly work is partial and will carry forward. Documentation was reviewed; no discovered application was installed or run. Search failures, truncated queries, source-group gaps and unresolved licenses remain visible; this is broad bounded research, not an exhaustive inventory. Collection attempted every planned query; eight repository queries failed, nine were partial, and 116 reached configured bounds.
